subject: Interlock: account ownership inventory + next steps
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, partnerships@novaedge.com
Date: 2026-10-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Interlock: account ownership inventory + next steps

Team,

Following up on yesterday's sync — NovaEdge reported a handful of mid-market accounts that appear in both our pipeline and their channel overlay. To avoid double-work and confusing outreach for Q4, we need a short ownership inventory and a proposal for handback / co-sell routing.

Action items I'm asking for from each region rep (aiming for EOD PDT tomorrow):
- Quick inventory: list any active opportunities >= $25k where you have outreach in the last 60 days (attach wins/lost flags).
- Proposed owner: who should lead outbound (Redwood AE / NovaEdge / joint) and why.
- Escalation notes: any contractual concerns (SLA, data residency, exclusivity asks).

I've attached a starter CSV (account-inventory.csv) with the NovaEdge list they shared. Please populate your rows directly and drop the handback-matrix.xlsx back in the thread when ready.

Why now: NovaEdge expects a single routing decision before their marketplace co-sell kickoff Nov 1. If we can't agree, they'll default to their CS-driven playbook which will likely exclude Redwood-led outreach.

Thanks — try to be terse; we'll consolidate and propose a single handoff rule set.

--
Chloe Martin
Director, Partner GTM 
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: account-inventory.csv (csv)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-10-19T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interlock: account ownership inventory + next steps

Chloe / team — jumping in with an initial pass.

I pulled our SFDC list and mapped NovaEdge's names to our accounts. High-level notes:
- 8 accounts overlap where NovaEdge has a named champion and we have active discovery (MQL -> SQL in last 30 days).
- 5 accounts are purely integration inquiries (tooling evaluation) — those should be partner-led with Redwood supporting technical reference.
- 2 accounts are strategic and should be joint-managed (we have procurement conversations ongoing).

I'll attach a draft handback matrix; it's conservative: where we have an open forecast and >1 intro in 60 days, we retain primary outreach. NovaEdge gets co-sell credit and discovery handoff for integration-only deals.

Quick asks for Chloe: can we escalate for the 2 strategic accounts to AE leadership if NovaEdge insists on sole ownership? We want to protect motion and renewal path.

Attaching handback-matrix.xlsx — filled columns: recommended_owner, rationale, handback_trigger.

--
Marissa Cole
Sr. Partner Manager, Alliances
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: handback-matrix.xlsx (xlsx)]

Hi Chloe / Marissa,

Thanks for the quick turnaround — appreciate the matrix. A couple clarifying points from NovaEdge's side:
- Account "Crestline Analytics" shows a NovaEdge-led POC and a Redwood inbound demo last week. We'd propose NovaEdge own the POC and Redwood handle the demo follow-up jointly.
- For the two strategic accounts Marissa flagged (BeaconRetail + OmniCloud), NovaEdge is comfortable joint-managing but asks that Redwood own commercial negotiations since you already have procurement engagement.
- We can accept joint-managed tags in the marketplace, but we'd like a single point of contact to avoid duplicate outreach; prefer AE-level handoffs.

We're ok with the conservative matrix Marissa shared as long as Redwood agrees to two things:
1) AE-level contact for commercial handoffs (name & calendar link).
2) A 30-day escalation SLA if outreach conflicts occur (we recommend a 48-hr response expectation for claim disputes).

Schedule: can we lock a 30-minute alignment call tomorrow (Oct 20) 10:00am PT to finalize?

Best,
NovaEdge Partner Ops
NovaEdge

1) Ownership rules (final):
- Integration-only inquiries -> NovaEdge primary, Redwood technical support.
- Active commercial pipeline (forecasted opp > $25k with active AE engagement) -> Redwood primary, NovaEdge co-sell.
- Strategic (BeaconRetail, OmniCloud) -> Joint-managed; Redwood to lead negotiations.

2) Handoff mechanics:
- AE owners: Jonas Weber (jonas.weber@redwood.com) for BeaconRetail; Karthik Iyer (karthik.iyer@redwood.com) for OmniCloud.
- We'll add these owners to the NovaEdge marketplace entries and share Calendly links on the call.

3) Escalation SLA:
- 48-hr initial response for ownership disputes; 30-day full resolution target.

Next steps:
- Quick alignment call: tomorrow 10:00am PT works for me — calendar invite sent (link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c4d-partner-inventory).
- Marissa / Jonas / Karthik: please update the account-inventory.csv with owner names/notes after the call so I can publish the canonical handback doc.

I'll close with a short public note to GTM after we publish the canonical doc so reps stop duplicating outreach.
